governing_constraints.product_record_root_adoption: Verified in invocation as prospective adoption only; not a process-stage or product decision

human_decision_basis.source_classification: Reported and source-qualified in the continuation summary and prior process evidence; original raw ask_user wording unavailable verbatim
decisions: Use Critical, High, Medium, and Low for urgency; shared value set does not equate urgency with Ticket.Priority and no mapping is allowed.

Support Agent access/review is limited to currently assigned tickets; Support Manager to currently assigned teams including team-queued tickets; Tenant Admin to own tenant; Platform Admin has no individual ticket urgency access.

Acceptance copies SuggestedUrgency to ReviewedUrgency; override stores a valid selected value; preserve suggestion and record reviewer/time metadata; urgency review never changes Ticket.Priority; separate Priority changes use FR-TM-14.

reviewed_cross_references.assessment: Values, distinct urgency/priority semantics, authorization, revalidation, acceptance/override behavior, preservation, reviewer/time metadata, and 90-day retention are explicit.

reviewed_cross_references.section: centralized default-deny permission catalogue and role mapping
reviewed_cross_references.assessment: TicketAIResult read/review permission and role scopes align with FR-TK-09; no role or exception added.
Urgency review updates only review metadata; FR-TM-14 remains the separate Priority workflow.
SuggestedUrgency and nullable ReviewedUrgency plus reviewer/time and model/deployment metadata are aligned; schema details remain planning decisions.

reviewed_cross_references.section: acceptance criteria and Definition of Done
reviewed_cross_references.assessment: Allowed values, scopes, acceptance/override, preservation, Priority non-mutation, Platform Admin denial, and retention are testable.

verification_assessments.basis: Current analysis covers the prior v1.10 baseline and all substantive v1.11 urgency changes and linked cross-references.
No unapproved scope expansion, unsupported assumption, or implementation decision was found.
The qualified decisions are reflected consistently across requirement, permissions, workflow, entity/API, acceptance, test, and DoD sections.
Authorization, privacy, retention, operational constraints, and deferred provider/model decisions are represented without inventing new requirements.
Changed behaviors and failure boundaries have measurable acceptance/test coverage.
RA20-Q-01 is addressed; remaining §17 decisions are explicitly deferred and correctly treated as non-blocking for this analysis.
Exact schema, indexes, endpoints, and sequencing remain for planning; illustrative technical impacts are not promoted to requirements.

findings.evidence: The prior human-decision-source-qualification.json and current Analysis report state that the original ask_user wording is not available verbatim; the resumed user summary provides the qualified decision set.
findings.impact: The verifier can assess incorporation against source-qualified reported decisions, but cannot independently compare the exact original wording. The current report discloses this and no mismatch was found against the qualified decision set.
findings.recommended_action: Retain the provenance qualification. Human Requirement Approval should review the listed decision set; no requirement correction is required solely for the unavailable transcript.

evidence_classification.executed: Independent review of full source and updated requirement, v1.10-to-v1.11 changes, complete current analysis, decision qualification, and cross-section traceability; exact hashes and byte counts recorded for bound inputs.
evidence_classification.source_inspection: v1.10/v1.11 requirement text, current and prior Requirement Analysis reports/evidence/results, Requirement Update report, qualified decision evidence, Verification Prompt and Guideline, and adopted Master baseline fingerprint status.
evidence_classification.reported: The user-supplied continuation summary and prior source qualification for the three RA20-Q-01 decisions; initiation response authorize_requirement_analysis_verification.
evidence_classification.unverified: The original raw wording of the earlier ask_user response; no transcript claim is made.

evidence_caveats: Current Analysis result.json contains a null duplicate nested provenance field; the bound Analysis report and analysis-evidence.json preserve the qualification, and this verification relied on those linked canonical records rather than treating the null duplicate as evidence.
The user-provided adoption permalink and master-baseline status are recorded in the invocation; adoption does not itself authorize Requirement Approval.
